integrity: The proof establishes the stated if-and-only-if boundary with an exact all-index coefficient certificate and explicit negative asymptotic test vectors; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the normalized unweighted analytic Bergman disk and the two specified monomials.
No general criterion for other symbols or weights is asserted.
Finite checker tests supplement but do not certify the infinite-dimensional proof.
Historical priority is qualified because existing general sufficient row tests could admit a previously unnoticed specialization.
title: A sharp boundary-Jacobian criterion for a two-angular-mode Bergman Toeplitz family
